g.title: GDM_QSP
g.text: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Placental Contra-Insulin Drive → Maternal Insulin Resistance → FAILURE of β-Cell Compensation → Maternal Hyperglycaemia
GLUT1 Placental Transfer → Pedersen/Freinkel Fetal Hyperinsulinism → Asymmetric Fetal Overgrowth · Neonatal & Life-Course Programming
Therapy: MNT/Exercise · Metformin (crosses placenta) · Insulin (does not) · Glyburide (BCRP-effluxed)
